description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.79 each) capped at 19999, causes [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (25s)], grants [PHY +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies, grants [Dual Awoken President Salaheem Mode I] and [XI Resonance +3% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken President Salaheem Mode I
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Support abilities, chases support abilities with President's Command

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken President Salaheem Mode II], removes [Dual Awoken President Salaheem Mode I]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken President Salaheem Mode II
description.text: Cast speed x999999 for support abilities, chases Support abilities with Extraordinary Bonus

description.name: Extraordinary Bonus
description.text: Grants [100% Critical 1],  [Critical Damage +50% 1], [Deadly Strikes +20% 1] and [Instant Cast 1] to all allies

description.name: Critical Damage +50% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (25s)
description.text: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50%

description.name: XI Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is XI
